name: Pravuil, the Recording Angel
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. The finale's dealer while Death plays: front-on, never mirrored; 'near' is the hand on the LEFT of the picture (flat on the felt), 'far' the one on the right (on the deck, the deck with it). The master is the rest pose's own head, the face layers on it (eyes, two mouths). Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head. No tells: he is the house.

what.A1: Rest: one hand flat on the felt, the other on the deck
what.A2: Thumbing the top card off the deck
what.A3: Pitching a card to the left of the picture
what.A4: Sliding a card toward the viewer
what.A5: Pitching a card to the right of the picture
what.A6: Burning a card beside the deck
what.C1: Pushing the pot to the left of the picture
what.C2: Pushing the pot toward the viewer
what.C3: Pushing the pot to the right of the picture
what.C4: Taking the quill from behind his ear
what.C5: The folded wings settling, a small shrug (motion strokes beside the wings: dropped)

rest.what: the hand on the left of the picture, flat on the felt, with its sleeve
the hand on the right of the picture, on the deck (the deck with it)
